//--------------------------------------------------------------------
//  Strategy Parameters
//--------------------------------------------------------------------
int MagicNumber = 11111;
int StdDevPeriod1 = 50;
int StdDevPeriod2 = 20;
int ExitAfterBars1 = 5;
double ProfitTargetCoef1 = 3.1;
double StopLossCoef1 = 2.5;
double TrailingStopCoef1 = 1.7;

Main chart = Current Symbol / Current TF;

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading options logic
//--------------------------------------------------------------------

Don't Trade On Weekends = false (Friday 1600 - Sunday 2359);
Exit at End Of Day = false (1530);
Exit On Friday = false (2259);
LimitSignalsTimeRange = true (0130 - 2330, Exit at End: false, Orders to close: All);
LimitMaxDistanceFromMarketPrice = false;   //Limit max distance
MaxDistanceFromMarketPct = 6;   //Max distance %
MaxTradesPerDay = 0;
Min SL: 0, Max SL: 0, Min PT: 0, Max PT: 0; // in ticks/pips, 0 means unlimited


//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Trading signals (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
LongEntrySignal = ((StdDev(Main chart,StdDevPeriod1, PRICE_OPEN)[1] is higher than StdDev(Main chart,StdDevPeriod2, PRICE_CLOSE)[1] for 5 bars)
   and (LowestInRange(Main chart, "14:00", "4:00")[1] >= Fibo(Main chart, High-Low previous day, Fibo Level = 23.6)[]));

ShortEntrySignal = false;

LongExitSignal = (false
   and false);

ShortExitSignal = (false
   and false);


//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Long entry (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if LongEntrySignal
{
    // Action #1
    Open Long order at Market;
        Duplicate trades: disabled;
        Stop Loss = StopLossCoef1 * ATR(60);
        Profit target = ProfitTargetCoef1 * ATR(100);

        Trailing Stop = TrailingStopCoef1 * ATR(104);

        Exit After ExitAfterBars1 bars;

}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Short entry (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if (ShortEntrySignal
   and Not LongEntrySignal)
{
}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Long exit (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if ((LongExitSignal
   and Not LongEntrySignal)
   and (MarketPosition("Any", MagicNumber, "") is Long))
{
    // Action #1
    Close all positions for Symbol = Any and Magic Number = MagicNumber;

}

//--------------------------------------------------------------------
// Trading rule: Short exit (On Bar Open)
//--------------------------------------------------------------------           
if ((ShortExitSignal
   and Not ShortEntrySignal)
   and (MarketPosition("Any", MagicNumber, "") is Short))
{
    // Action #1
    Close all positions for Symbol = Any and Magic Number = MagicNumber;

}
